entities.summary: Masaru Nagai (b. 1978-05-20, Itoigawa) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Itoigawa and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
